objective: Expose a local, effect-free CLI for independently specified PQ-07G manifest intake, printing unqualified raw-case coverage and failing closed on unsafe inputs; make operator evidence gathering reproducible without new network/CI effects.
nonGoals: No production qualification, publisher/CI issuer authentication or release rights
No external effect, network dependency, secret or service deployment
No modification of baseline CI/merge gate
decisions: CLI requires exact operator supplied candidate/policy/manifest digests, and only inventories raw local evidence
No implicit default trust policy, remote URL fetch, effect credential or existing-project mutation
Exit 0 means an assessment was computed, not production acceptance; error exit 2 means invalid/unavailable input

obligations.description: CLI parses exact pins and produces machine-readable NO-GO states for missing/present raw cases
Reject bad digests, input errors and arbitrary qualification flags; never perform mutation or network

impact: No change to installed sf CLI or existing qualification outputs

budget.hostedRuns: one PR-stage run on draft creation

externalEffects: Draft stacked PR #47; PR #50 reserved for cumulative protected integration
No target mutation or PQ-08 publication
